capabilities: List the focused note's tasks in a sidebar panel
Filter tasks by open, completed or all with per-filter counts
Tick checkboxes in the panel and write the change to the file
Jump to a task's line by clicking its row
Group tasks under their nearest heading
disambiguation: Lists tasks only in the note currently in focus, not vault-wide task queries like the Tasks plugin's search blocks.
extras: Requires Obsidian 1.6.0 or later; runs on desktop and mobile. Falls back to plain checkbox toggling when Tasks is not installed.
problem: Obsidian offers no per-note task panel, so seeing and ticking a long note's checkboxes means scrolling through it.

relations.evidence: ticking a checkbox in the panel hands the toggle to that plugin
follows the note in focus the way the Calendar plugin follows the active date

summary: Sidebar panel that lists the checkboxes of the note in focus, filterable by status, with clickable jumps and checkbox ticking written back to the file.
